name: Continuation of Pension (K.B.O.C.W.W.B)
_eligibility_text:
> ***For Registration as a Building/ Construction Worker:***

  - The applicant should be a Building/ Construction Worker (Unorganised Worker).
  - The applicant should be a minimum of 18 years of age.
  - The applicant should have engaged in building and construction work for at least 90 days in a given year.

> **For the Application of the Welfare Scheme:**

  - The beneficiary should be a registered construction worker Under the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board of Karnataka.
  - The worker should have paid subscription fees for at least three (3) continuous years.
  - The worker should remain an active construction worker.
  - The worker’s age should be below 60 years.
  - The worker shall not avail similar benefits under any of the Government Schemes.
